current_objective: None yet. Pip Applebrook lives a quiet life in Greenhollow and intends to keep it that way.

major_events.event: Long ago the Everseed, a golden ring grown from a single apple seed, was torn from Malgrath the Charred King and lost.

perriwick.notes: Has been researching the Everseed for years.

shrivel.notes: Once carried the Everseed and was rotted by it.

relationships.status: the wizard is an old family friend
old rivals who secretly respect each other

villain_state: Malgrath is dormant and weakened in Cinderpith, but can faintly sense the Everseed whenever it glows.
unresolved_plot_points: Where did Perriwick find the Everseed?
Why has the Everseed started glowing again?
world_notes: The Everseed is a golden ring grown from a single apple seed; it whispers, and fruit near it ripens too fast.
Greenhollow homes are hollowed-out giant gourds.
Fruit-headed folk fear rot above all else.
